name: task-experience-loop
description: Keep project-scoped tasks, decisions, and reusable agent experience in local Markdown.

interface.shortDescription: Local, auditable memory for long-running agent work
interface.longDescription: Task Experience Loop gives Codex a local memory layer for project-scoped tasks, durable decisions, and reusable working patterns. The plugin bundles the TEL protocol and action-oriented SOP skills while keeping the Python CLI and user data separate.
defaultPrompt: Use TEL to load this project's context and continue the active task.
Record this decision in TEL if it will matter in future work.
Review my TEL memory pool and propose safe cleanup.
